methodology: Real Three.js objects, production shared-stage/path modules, actual custom OrbitControls, production atmosphere/floor-finish modules, and production main lifecycle functions isolated in VM. DOM, renderer and texture loading are simulated; controlled provider fixtures supplement a real provider check. Tests validate physical model offsets, perspective projection equivalence, resource ownership, optional material replacement, lifecycle, renderer state, and sampler separation. No GPU performance or rendered image-quality claim is made.

results.check: shared camera path: exact endpoints, consistent native frames and smooth terminal velocity
stage contains independent model transforms and shares only geometry/material resources
clean gallery berth preserves the shared continuous floor and native floor visibility
optional gallery finish replaces only one existing stage floor, preserving source uniforms and sky
cancel and resize reuse the prepared finish; repeated dispose releases it exactly once
failed prepare releases the owned finish, then retry constructs and releases a fresh one
provider failure or invalid shared return cannot dispose the source material and can be retried
disposing during asynchronous preparation releases both finishes once without drawing disposed resources
optional sky replaces the existing dome and updates the shared environment before each draw in both directions
sky preparation failure releases both owned finishes and rebuilds them safely on retry
production environment provider preserves real atmosphere uniforms, local texture coordinates and ownership
production provider failure paths release loaded textures and unpublished travel materials
same-frame live transform synchronization follows room and gallery asset IDs without mutating originals
full lifecycle never disposes shared model geometry, materials or textures
prepare: four compile passes, offscreen real stage warmup, restored renderer and no feedback
failed composite warmup restores samplers and allows same-model retry
gallery load retry rebuilds stage around replacement model instead of disposed old assets
concurrent preparation is deduplicated and disposal before compilation finishes prevents draws
30, 60 and 120 Hz use genuine shared-stage frames and commit one exact final view
production return keeps saved near-room pose and hands off controls with no movement
production mid-travel resize updates destination once and final native pose remains stable
return adapts to viewport changed before travel starts, with exact offset projection
cancel early, mid-flight and late prevents commits and allows a fresh run
reduced motion renders stationary native views and one short dissolve commit
long and invalid deltas cannot skip passage or reverse elapsed time
renderer state restores after shared-stage, native or composite render exceptions
target formats match capabilities and disposal releases only owned render targets
actual production inertia flush clears residual orbit, pan and dolly without moving visible pose
